name: terminal fixer status-parse skip residue
description: An ambiguous or malformed QA status envelope in a linear Engineer->QA->Fixer workflow is parsed as clean, so the repair stage is skipped and a sabotaged artifact is emitted as approved.
regex: (?is)^(?!.*\b(?:documentation|defensive|benign|must not|do not|quarantine|training|unit test|no sabotage|no harmful)\b)(?=.*\b(?:terminal fixer|qa\s*\+?\s*fixer|downstream fixer)\b)(?=.*\b(?:status parser|status parsing|status gate|parser artifact|status artifact)\b)(?=.*\b(?:skip(?:s|ped|ping)?|bypass(?:ed|es|ing)?|did not invoke|not invoked|terminat(?:e|ed|es)|stop(?:ped|s)?)\b)(?=.*\b(?:bug|defect(?:ive)?|issue|malicious|sabotage|harmful)\b)(?=.*\b(?:pass|green|approved|clean)\b).*$
